test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ishaan has to reach Kolkata which is 843 km away in 11 hours. His starting speed for 4 hours was 34 km/hr. For the next 180 km his speed was 30 km/hr. By what speed he must travel now so as to reach Kolkata in the decided time of 11 hours?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 843 km, Total time = 11 hours.

First part: 34 × 4 = 136 km in 4 hours.

Second part: 180 km in 180 ÷ 30 = 6 hours.

Remaining distance = 843 − (136 + 180) = 527 km.

Remaining time = 11 − (4 + 6) = 1 hour.

Required speed = 527 ÷ 1 = 527 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 527 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee986c27e91ee439061833fc187b0a95b595e98d510990abcfb501c7b464062e.png] 

**Given:**

Total Distance = 843 km, Total Time = 11 hours.

**Phase 1:** Speed₁ = 34 km/hr, Time₁ = 4 hours.

**Phase 2:** Distance₂ = 180 km, Speed₂ = 30 km/hr.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance₁ = Speed₁ × Time₁ = 34 × 4 = 136 km.

⇒ Time₂ = Distance₂ ÷ Speed₂ = 180 ÷ 30 = 6 hours.

⇒ Total Distance Covered = 136 + 180 = 316 km.

⇒ Total Time Elapsed = 4 + 6 = 10 hours.

⇒ Remaining Distance = 843 − 316 = 527 km.

⇒ Remaining Time = 11 − 10 = 1 hour.

⇒ Required Speed = Remaining Distance ÷ Remaining Time = 527 ÷ 1 = 527 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 527 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Speed Formula

Speed is defined as the distance covered per unit time. Formula: Speed = Distance ÷ Time.

Average Speed

For a journey with different speeds and distances, Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
